description: What the thumbnail should say and show, plus which words carry the hook. Additive optional fields only, so this is a MINOR bump per RFC 0007: existing 1.0.0 briefs stay valid, consumers on ^1 keep working, and no migrator is needed.

text.description: Overlay text, set in stacked capitals. Up to 48 characters now that it wraps across lines rather than shrinking to one — the renderer breaks and sizes it to fit the column it picks.

background_query.description: Stock photo search terms for the background. Concrete nouns only — stock libraries match subjects, not concepts.

accent.description: Text colour as #RRGGBB. Must stay legible on a darkened band.

rationale.description: Why this framing earns the click. Recorded so a weak thumbnail can be diagnosed rather than guessed at.

alternatives.description: Other text options, strongest first. Unused today; the raw material for thumbnail A/B once the feedback loop exists.

emphasis.description: The words within `text` that carry the hook — a contiguous phrase, copied exactly. Rendered large in the accent colour while the rest stays white and smaller. Omit only when every word matters equally; a thumbnail with no emphasis has no focal point.
